openssl 3.5.5 (one pinned source for both platforms)

windows-x64: openssl 3.5.5 built from pinned source (openssl-3.5.5 tag,
        commit 67b5686b4419b4cb8caa502711c41815f5279751).
        Build 2026-11-07 in MSYS2 (ucrt64 environment - matches the UCRT CRT
        the cp3c Windows toolchain uses; mingw64/msvcrt archives were found
        incompatible): gcc 16.2.0 Rev6 (Built by MSYS2 project, x86_64-w64-mingw32),
        perl 5.42.3, GNU make 4.4.1; configure `./Configure mingw64
        no-tests no-apps -O3`.
        No MSYS2 distribution ships in any package; the toolchain is the
        local build host only. The superseded mingw-w64-x86_64-openssl-3.5.4-1
        package checksums are retained in ossl-3.5.4-package.sha256 for the
        audit trail.
openssl-headers: carried over from the linux 3.5.5 build; identical
        source for both platforms (headers are platform-independent); both
        platform archives are built from the same pinned tree (C:\ossl-ucrt).
linux-x64: openssl 3.5.5 built from pinned source (openssl-3.5.5 tag,
        commit 67b5686b4419b4cb8caa502711c41815f5279751, build 2026-11-07
        WSL2 Ubuntu, gcc 15.2.0, configure linux-x86_64 no-shared no-tests no-apps)
windows-arm64: openssl 3.5.5 built from pinned source (openssl-3.5.5 tag,
        commit 67b5686b4419b4cb8caa502711c41815f5279751, build 2026-11-08
        on Windows with llvm-mingw 20261104 (LLVM 23.1.5, ucrt, x86_64 host),
        configure `mingw-arm64 no-shared no-tests no-apps no-module -O3`
        (custom no-asm target, vendor/third_party/openssl/mingw-arm64.conf,
        inherited via OPENSSL_LOCAL_CONFIG_DIR), providers linked statically).
linux-arm64: openssl 3.5.5 built from pinned source (openssl-3.5.5 tag,
        commit 67b5686b4419b4cb8caa502711c41815f5279751, build 2026-11-08
        WSL2 Ubuntu, aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc 15.2.0, Configure linux-aarch64
        no-shared no-tests no-apps). The native row now selects this archive and
        TLS is available for linux-arm64 programs.
release: v0.2.0 (first TLS-enabled release).
Source tag: https://github.com/openssl/openssl (openssl-3.5.5)
CA bundle: Mozilla, vendor/third_party/openssl/cacert.pem (see cacert-source-url.txt),
embedded into TLS-linked binaries at compile time (no runtime file lookup,
no source-tree dependency).
